tasks.check: grep -q 'DIAG_DONE' diag.txt || { echo 'FAIL: diagnosis did not finish:'; tail -5 diag.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^MSGS=|MSGS=[0-9]+' diag.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no message count'; exit 1; }; m=$(grep -cE '^MSG ' diag.txt); [ "$m" -ge 2 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $m messages retrieved"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'NODE_NOW=' diag.txt); $m messages; $(grep -m1 'GWLOG_LINES=' diag.txt)"
